## Episode conclusion (advisory, not acceptance)

Intent: DELIVER
Statement: The repeated acceptance rejection is now reproduced at its real ordering, not only at the guard entry point. The earlier oracles built or checked out the Git worktree BEFORE installing the guard. The candidate probe launches the product first and materializes the worktree afterwards: launch honestly reports "repository is not a readable Git worktree", the continuity pulse still answers from the sealed owner state, the fixed executor merges the prepared review, and the journal keeps no record for MAINTENANCE-REVIEW.md. The new sealed oracle scripts/pnwf/software/self-maintenance-late-guard.mjs reproduces exactly that sequence over the case-1/case-2 owner databases and receipt commits. On pre-fix 9c7c3d2 it exits 1 with 16 false checks: no hook after pulse, no new delivery, no artifact/commit/digest, no reuse on the next pulse, and the canonical basis check fails. On 2ba8c7f it passes 28/28 for both arms, including a control that merges without a pulse and still records nothing.

Fix in 2ba8c7f: ensureDirectDeliveryGuard reuses an exact matching installation or installs it now; the continuity pulse calls a host wiring preflight before deriving its view; launchDeployment and installProduct keep a mutable guard handle, force a fresh installation at startup when the worktree already exists, retry idempotently on pulse when it did not, and dispose only their own hooks. The guard still refreshes only an EXISTING principal DELIVER conclusion. It creates no judgement, accepts nothing, promotes nothing, and leaves the canonical head alone.

Verification: late-world sealed oracle 28/28; sealed guard 22/22; direct guard 13/13; control 6/6; delivery-artifacts 12/12 (adjusted so its intentional no-guard phase removes the guard AFTER the last pulse); delivery-required 12/12; pulse 7/7; readiness 6/6; tsc clean; vitest pnwf_direct_guard 4/4 and alhs_episode_convergence 13/13; broader deployment/product/continuity suites 45/47, with the two failures only missing untracked files (e2e/project-workspace.spec.ts and examples/deployment) in this isolated checkout. Limit: this repairs hook wiring before the merge; it does not make a non-compliant executor call conclude, and the external acceptance probe still has to be rerun against the new candidate. Operator acceptance and the canonical-head decision remain with the operator.
